description: Evaluation set for the synthetic Northwind Capital lending policy. expected_page refers to the page numbering of data/sample/northwind_lending_policy.pdf. answerable=false marks questions whose answer is deliberately absent from the document, used to check that the system abstains instead of guessing.

questions.question: What is the maximum loan tenure?
What is the minimum age for a loan applicant?
What is the maximum loan amount that can be approved?
What is the minimum monthly net income required for an applicant?
Which documents are required to submit with a new loan application?
questions.expected_answer: Proof of identity, proof of address, proof of income, proof of employment, bank statements and a signed credit agreement with direct debit mandate

questions.question: How long is an incomplete application held before it is closed?
What is the standard annual percentage rate for unsecured loans?
Is there a penalty for repaying a loan early?
questions.expected_answer: No, prepayment is permitted at any time without penalty

questions.question: What processing fee is charged and when?
questions.expected_answer: A one-off fee of 1.5 percent of the approved principal, charged at disbursement

questions.question: What insurance is required for a loan secured against a property?
questions.expected_answer: A property insurance policy for the full duration of the loan, naming the lender as loss payee

questions.question: Within how many business days is a credit decision communicated to the applicant?
questions.expected_answer: 3 business days of receiving a complete application

questions.question: How long are loan records retained after the final settlement?
questions.expected_answer: 7 years from the date of final settlement

questions.question: Can a customer request a copy of the personal data held about them?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, free of charge, at any time

questions.question: How many retail branches does Northwind Capital operate?
What is the petrol pump financing limit for artisanal businesses?
Which sports club does Northwind Capital sponsor?
